title: GERD consultation: synthetic simulation
description: A fictional gastroenterology consultation with symptom review, medication reconciliation, evidence grounding, clinician verification, note generation, and structured export.
synthetic_notice: Entirely fictional. Not derived from any real patient or encounter.

segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: What symptoms brought you in today?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: I get a burning feeling behind my breastbone after dinner three or four nights a week, especially after a late meal.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Sometimes I also get a sour taste coming back into my mouth when I lie down.

segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: Any trouble swallowing, vomiting blood, black stools, or weight loss you did not intend?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: No trouble swallowing, no vomiting blood, no black stools, and my weight has been steady.

segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: Are you still taking omeprazole 20 milligrams each morning?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Yes. It helps most days, but I still get breakthrough burning after late meals.

segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: Your symptom pattern is consistent with gastroesophageal reflux disease. Continue omeprazole 20 milligrams daily, and we will review your response at follow-up.
